title: HackerEarth: Monk and Order of Phoenix (Army Heights)
description: Monk needs to choose one fighter from each row in `stacks` such that their heights are strictly increasing from top row to bottom row. Return `True` if possible, `False` otherwise.
constraints:
1 <= len(stacks) <= 1000
• Time: O(R log C) | Space: O(1)
explanation: Greedy choice: at each row, select smallest element strictly greater than prior row's selection using binary search in O(R log C) time.
